I need to run a program that parses input manually to build from a prompt. I’ll focus on creating an output based on a 25x22 grid, noting a vertical line at column 6. An object in color 4 is near the lower right, and the program might shift this object to touch the line, generating eight stripes on the opposite side. I’ll quickly build rows from the description using Python lists and ensure each row consists of 22 values, considering zero-indexing for rows.**Building the grid from image text**

I’m extracting information from the image text to build the grid. Rows 0-14 will all be filled with 1s except for column 6, which will be 2. For rows 15-16, columns 8 to 13 will have the value 4. Row 17 has columns 8-11 as 4, columns 12-13 as background 1, and column 14 as 4. I'll continue for each row, keeping track of columns and their values to construct the object bounding box from rows 15-22. Let’s get started!

import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('prog',p); m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)
g=[[1]*22 for _ in range(25)]
for row in g: row[6]=2
for r in (15,16):
    for c in range(8,14): g[r][c]=4
for c in range(8,12): g[17][c]=4; g[18][c]=4; g[19][c]=4
g[17][14]=4
for r in (18,19): g[r][12]=4; g[r][14]=4
for c in range(8,15): g[20][c]=4
g[21][8]=g[21][9]=4
for c in range(11,15): g[21][c]=4
for c in range(8,14): g[22][c]=4
out=m.transform(g)
print(len(out),len(out[0]))
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in out))
